From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@finscale.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Exec sponsor requested for architecture deep-dive — scheduling windows

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. We'd like to schedule a focused architecture deep-dive next week to walk through: serving topology, data flow for inference, caching strategy, and security controls (KMS/HSM + audit logs).

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether FinScale will have an executive sponsor (CTO or Head of Engineering) join the 45–60 minute session? Their presence helps us align on rollout risk and SLA expectations.
- Please pick any 1–2 windows that work for your team from the options below so we can lock a slot. We’ll route the agenda accordingly.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 13 Apr, 10:00–11:00
- Tue 13 Apr, 14:00–15:00
- Wed 14 Apr, 09:00–10:00

Attached is a short agenda and a current network diagram for reference. If a different time is better for leadership, happy to accommodate — just let me know which time zone your sponsor is in.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700

Monica,

Thanks — appreciate the clear agenda. CTO (Lena Ortiz) is available but only for an early window on Tue — she has a board commitment later that day. Of your proposed times, Tue 13 Apr 10:00–11:00 PT works best for her and our platform folks.

Two follow-ups from our side:
- Can the session include a short section (10m) on your fallback and graceful degradation approach when you fall back from high-capacity GPU fleets?
- We also want to share our IAM / network constraints in advance. Attaching a brief internal note.

Jordan
Jordan Hale | Head of Platform Engineering, FinScale
jordan.hale@finscale.com | +1 (650) 555-1212
